page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, alongside 96 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It operates under a KVM hypervisor and incorporates 48 MB of L3 cache along with hardware instruction sets like AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA_NI. The instance provides a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains zero GPUs, and does not include bundled local storage capacity.

Performance testing indicates average-tier execution across general compute and memory tasks. The instance achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1587.0, a multi-core score of 11900.0, and a Passmark CPU score of 28868.06. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 127.7 GB/sec, while write bandwidth measures 63.99 GB/sec. In application benchmarks, it handles 23.52 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a small 135M model LLM text generation speed of 294.62 tokens per second. A primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of local NVMe storage, requiring attached network volumes for persistent storage demands.

Qualitative cost efficiency stems from its balanced resource density, offering predictable compute and memory scaling without paying a premium for specialized memory ratios or hardware accelerators. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is suited for general-purpose application backends, Redis caching clusters, web serving infrastructure, software compilation pipelines, and lightweight inference workloads.
